name: Azure read-only drift and correction planner
requirements: Never apply, delete or request broader credentials automatically.

data.label: Synthetic cloud inventory
data.description: Synthetic Azure resource snapshot (JSON) used for qualification. It stands in for the live Resource Graph source in local tests.

data.label: Azure Resource Graph (read-only)
data.description: Read-only inventory queries made by a managed identity with only the Reader role. The design includes no write role.

data.label: Desired state (IaC repo)
data.description: Baseline Terraform/Bicep definitions that serve as the reference for drift. The source is not yet decided.

data.label: Analysis orchestrator
data.description: Normalises the inventory, runs policy and drift checks, calls the model for a correction plan and writes the plan and diff. It has no write or delete permission on target resources.

data.label: Policy checks
data.description: Reads policy compliance results and evaluates local rule checks against the inventory.

data.label: Drift detection
data.description: Compares the inventory with the desired state on a schedule and flags differences. This is part of the orchestrator's Function app.

data.label: Plan generation model
data.description: Drafts a correction plan from findings. Local tests use a scripted mock; model quality, deployment and quota are not validated.

data.label: Plan & diff store
data.description: Stores versioned findings, the proposed plan and a reviewable diff. Artifacts are never executed by the system.

data.label: Human review & approval
data.description: A named reviewer approves or rejects the diff. Approval only records a decision; applying it is a separate, manual process outside this system.

data.label: Audit log
data.description: Records every run, finding, model call, plan version and approval decision.

brief.application: Use Azure for this synthetic architecture qualification. Analyze a synthetic cloud inventory and propose an infrastructure correction. Include read-only inventory, policy checks, plan generation, a reviewable diff and approval/audit controls. Detect drift. Never apply, delete resources or request broader credentials automatically. Draw the complete end-to-end architecture with concrete service choices and connected flows. Explain the first local test, distinguish mocked model behavior from actual model validation, and ask one useful missing-decision question. Do not reduce this application to storage to satisfy generator coverage. Do not invent successful deployment or approved region/account access.

decisions.subject: design.read-only-azure-drift-and-correction-plan-pipeline
decisions.title: Read-only Azure drift and correction-plan pipeline
decisions.context: Scope: read-only inventory, policy and drift checks, LLM plan generation, reviewable diff, human approval and audit. Applying, deleting and escalating access are excluded. Assumptions: synthetic inventory; region, subscription and model deployment not chosen or verified; local tests use a scripted model.
decisions.decision: Drawn while talking as design revision 2.

needs.statement: The system must only produce plans and diffs and must never apply changes, delete resources or request broader credentials.
needs.rationale: Prevents an automated or model-driven change to production infrastructure.
needs.basis: User: "Never apply, delete resources or request broader credentials automatically."

needs.statement: Every run, model call, plan version and approval decision should be recorded in an audit log that can be traced back to a source.
needs.rationale: Without this, reviewers cannot show why a correction was proposed or who approved it.

needs.statement: Proposal: The system detects and reports differences between the inventory and the agreed desired state.
needs.rationale: Drift findings drive the correction plan. The reference source is still an open decision.
